findings.note: Honest disclosure: the workload does NOT survive a 16 KiB thread stack — the measured bound is 32 KiB (page-granular), which includes the blake3 Hasher frame in Slot::write/read seal, the pnabi->pn64::fire call chain, std thread-entry overhead, and OS guard rounding. The 256B spec aspiration is satisfied only in its delta form (zero recursion => depth-1 fixed chain); total frame cost is ~2 orders of magnitude above 256B and the court does not claim otherwise. All static violations found during development were #[cfg(test)] code in cas_ring.rs/slot.rs, correctly excluded as non-state-path.
